title: Lucky Thirteen Botanicals Raspberry, Garden Mint & Lime 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Raspberry Garden Mint & Lime from Lucky Thirteen’s exquisite Botanical Collection is a deliciously refreshing e-liquid with a light, subtle sweetness from mint, rich, tangy fruit from raspberry and a zesty edge from lime. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , box mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks , producing rich clouds and immaculate flavour.
